prompts.title: 3D Football Player Caricature
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the male subject’s facial identity.

Create a premium high-end CGI render of the subject as a clearly miniature football character in a vertical 4:5 composition. He must not look like a normal adult footballer. Give him a compact mascot-style body with a slightly oversized head, short athletic limbs, a short torso, and a clearly miniaturized full-body appearance.

Dress him in the accurate home kit of [TEAM NAME] [FIFA World Cup 2026], including the correct jersey colors, pattern, shorts, socks, and football boots. Show him in a cool, stylish, confident pose with one foot resting on a FIFA football. Make the football relatively large compared to his body so the miniature scale is obvious.

Keep the expression cool, playful, and confident, with a subtle smirk or relaxed stylish smile.

Scene: seamless pure white studio background with a white floor and soft contact shadows. Full body visible, centered, and dominant in frame.

Rendering: ultra-premium realistic CGI, sharp and clean, with natural matte skin, realistic eyes, detailed hair strands, refined facial hair, realistic sportswear fabric, visible stitching, natural folds, detailed boots, and high-end studio lighting.

Avoid: normal adult body proportions, bad anatomy, life-size look, plastic toy look, bobblehead, waxy skin, glossy surfaces, cheap cartoon style, low-detail rendering, awkward anatomy, or generic football kit.

prompts.title: Mini Avatar Collection
prompts.prompt:
Create a square 1:1 collage featuring six premium 3D chibi-style renders of the same subject, arranged in a clean 3-column × 2-row grid. The subject should be reusable for any person, so use the uploaded/reference person as the base subject and transform them into a cute stylized 3D chibi character while keeping the same subject identity consistent across all six panels.

The character should have a charming animated look with an oversized head, large glossy eyes, soft rounded facial features, rosy cheeks, a small nose, a warm smile, and thick fluffy hair adapted from the subject. Keep the same subject consistent in all six panels, while changing only the outfit, pose, and expression according to each scene below.

Use soft studio lighting, rich vivid smooth gradient backgrounds with clean saturated color depth, where the outer area stays more solid and colorful while the area near the subject becomes lighter and softer, subtle floor shadows, crisp fabric textures, detailed hair strands, and a clean high-resolution polished finish. Add a soft subtle rim light along the outer edges of the subject, especially around the hair, shoulders, arms, and clothing silhouette, so the character stays clearly separated from the background without looking overlit.

Panel 1 — Top Left:
A full-body subject standing calmly with both hands inside the hoodie pocket, gentle friendly smile, looking at the camera.
Outfit: olive green hoodie, dark charcoal jogger pants, white low-top sneakers, small pendant necklace and wrist bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with sky-blue as the more solid outer color, becoming a lighter warm peach glow near the subject.

Panel 2 — Top Middle:
A confident stylish subject standing with hands in pockets, one eye winking, cheerful smile.
Outfit: backward dark baseball cap, blue denim jacket, black-and-white striped t-shirt, black slim jeans with rolled cuffs, black-and-white sneakers, headphones resting around the neck, wristwatch.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with bright aqua-to-teal as the more solid outer color, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 3 — Top Right:
A joyful energetic subject laughing with eyes closed, both arms raised in celebration.
Outfit: bright yellow sweatshirt with bold “PLAY” text, loose black joggers, colorful sporty sneakers.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with warm golden yellow and coral pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 4 — Bottom Left:
A thoughtful subject standing in a cute thinking pose, one hand touching the chin, soft serious expression.
Outfit: dark bomber jacket, white graphic t-shirt, tan cargo pants, high-top black-and-white sneakers, small backpack straps visible.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with lavender and soft pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 5 — Bottom Middle:
A relaxed subject sitting on a small wooden stool, holding a smartphone in one hand, calm pleasant smile.
Outfit: cream oversized sweatshirt, soft blue joggers, clean white sneakers, subtle bracelets.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with pastel green and pale yellow as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 6 — Bottom Right:
A cool fashionable subject standing with one hand in pocket and the other making a peace sign, confident playful smile.
Outfit: dark knit beanie, beige-and-black plaid overshirt over a black t-shirt, layered silver chain necklace, ripped black jeans, chunky sneakers, wristwatch and bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with blush pink and mint as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Overall style: ultra-clean premium 3D cartoon render, cute chibi proportions, detailed realistic clothing materials, expressive faces, smooth soft shading, polished cinematic character design, vibrant pastel color harmony, adorable social-media avatar aesthetic.

prompts.title: Miniature Me
prompts.prompt:

The main subject must look exactly like the person in the uploaded image, preserving identical facial structure, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, eye shape, nose shape, lips, jawline, and overall identity. Do not beautify, alter, or replace facial features.

Create a 4:5 aspect-ratio, cinematic, ultra-detailed scene of the subject smiling naturally in studio settings. prompts.title: Floating World Dioramas
prompts.prompt:
Create a 1:1 or 4:5 aspect-ratio, ultra-HD, hyper-realistic cinematic aerial poster of a floating miniature island shaped exactly like the real geographic outline of [COUNTRY NAME], suspended naturally above a vast sea of soft, volumetric clouds.
The island must look like a physical miniature diorama with realistic terrain thickness, layered geological cross-sections, cliffs, rock strata, soil layers, grass, and natural elevation depth visible along the island edges.
Automatically generate and place the most iconic landmarks, architecture, terrain features, and cultural elements of [COUNTRY NAME] in their geographically correct regions. Terrain must accurately reflect real biome distribution including mountains, rivers, coastlines, beaches, forests, deserts, or lakes depending on the country.
If the country has ocean borders or coastline, include ultra-realistic water with:
• crystal-clear turquoise shallow water near shores

• deep blue ocean gradients in deeper areas

• visible underwater terrain and shoreline fade

• realistic reflections, refraction, and light absorption

• gentle waves, foam, and coastal interaction

• subsurface scattering and transparency
Embed massive bold white 3D letters spelling "[COUNTRY NAME]" into the terrain, physically integrated with ground elevation, casting soft natural shadows.
Add realistic environmental storytelling elements:
• native animals and birds

• trees and biome-accurate vegetation

• roads, bridges, cities, or villages

• waterfalls, rivers, mist, and environmental depth
Lighting must be cinematic golden hour with:
• strong warm sunlight from horizon

• visible volumetric god rays passing through clouds

• atmospheric haze and aerial perspective

• soft light scattering

• realistic cloud shadows on terrain

• glowing sunlight reflections on water
Atmosphere must include volumetric clouds, depth fog, subtle mist, and realistic atmospheric perspective to enhance scale and realism.
Camera view: high-altitude aerial 3/4 perspective, slightly angled, centered composition, entire island fully visible.
Color grading: rich cinematic colors, vibrant but natural tones, high dynamic range, travel-poster quality.
Rendering quality: ultra-photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5, Octane render, physically based rendering (PBR), global illumination, ambient occlusion, subsurface scattering, ultra-detailed textures, sharp focus, 8K resolution.
Style: hyper-real miniature world, cinematic travel poster, ultra clean, premium, professional.
